steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: install-tracker
steps.eval: (() => { window.__selLog = []; const st = window.__store; window.__unsub = st.subscribe((s, prev) => { if (s.planSelection !== prev.planSelection) { window.__selLog.push({ t: performance.now()|0, sel: s.planSelection ? (s.planSelection.type+':'+s.planSelection.id) : null }); } }); return 'installed'; })()

steps.name: tap-wall
steps.eval: (() => { const g = document.querySelector('svg.plan-paper g[data-wall]'); if (!g) return 'NO_WALL'; const hit = g.querySelector('path'); const r = hit.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = r.left + r.width/2; const y = r.top + r.height/2; window.__tapWall = g.getAttribute('data-wall'); const fire = (type, btns) => hit.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, { bubbles:true, cancelable:true, clientX:x, clientY:y, button:0, buttons:btns, pointerId:7, pointerType:'touch' })); fire('pointerdown', 1); return { wall: window.__tapWall, x:Math.round(x), y:Math.round(y) }; })()

steps.name: tap-wall-up
steps.eval: (() => { const g = document.querySelector('svg.plan-paper g[data-wall="'+window.__tapWall+'"]'); const hit = g.querySelector('path'); const r = hit.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = r.left + r.width/2; const y = r.top + r.height/2; const fire = (type, btns) => hit.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, { bubbles:true, cancelable:true, clientX:x, clientY:y, button:0, buttons:btns, pointerId:7, pointerType:'touch' })); fire('pointerup', 0); return 'up'; })()

steps.name: report
steps.eval: (() => { const out = { finalSelection: window.__store.getState().planSelection, transitions: window.__selLog, inspectorPresent: !!document.querySelector('.plan-props') }; console.log('REPRO_REPORT ' + JSON.stringify(out)); return out; })()
